title: Company Founded
description: Started as a small dismantling yard on the outskirts of Delhi with a single facility.

title: RVSF Authorization
description: Became one of the first government-authorized vehicle scrapping facilities in North India.

title: Digital Valuation Launch
description: Introduced instant online quote technology, cutting valuation time from days to minutes.

title: Pan-India Expansion
description: Scaled pickup operations to over 60 cities through a certified partner network.

title: Corporate Fleet Division
description: Launched a dedicated division serving enterprise and government fleet disposal.

title: 100+ Cities Milestone
description: Crossed 15,000 vehicles processed and 100+ cities under active service coverage.
